beats.story: Monday morning wraps up a weekend of spiraling -- just me, my wine, and my ever uniquely anxious thoughts. It's still dark outside when I board the first bus -- the hardest bus ride because my stomach is still churning from my not-so-happy hour last night. I'd texted Cliff that I didn't need a ride. There's no way I'm going back into his car. When I arrive at the office, I have to switch on the floor lights. My footsteps echo through the barren room. As I brew the first pot of coffee for the club, I mourn the bitter scent, the gurgle of the machine. I mourn it all because it may well be the last.
beats.story_cn: 周一清晨包裹着周末遗留的辗转反侧——只剩我、葡萄酒，还有那些永远独特的焦虑思绪。登上首班公交车时窗外仍是一片漆黑——这程路最难熬，因为昨夜那场“不太愉快的酒局”仍在胃里翻腾。我给克里夫发了短信说不用他送。我绝不会再坐进他的车里。抵达办公室时，我得手动打开整层楼的灯。脚步声在空荡荡的房间里回响。当我为俱乐部煮第一壶咖啡时，我哀悼着那苦涩的气味，哀悼着咖啡机咕嘟咕嘟的声响。我哀悼这一切，因为这很可能就是最后一次了。

beats.story: I sit down at my desk and bring my monitor to life. All the regular programs open, sitting uselessly on the screen. Cliff's little icon indicates he's online; he came in early too. We're probably the only two people in this building. I wonder if he's also looking at my icon. Eventually, Rhonda trudges into the unit first, her big, embroidered bag heaving against her chest. I follow her movements as she walks toward her seat. All the questions I've been obsessing over all weekend scream inside my head: Does she know anything?
beats.story_cn: 我在办公桌前坐下，点亮显示器。所有常规程序逐一打开，徒然占据着屏幕。克里夫的小图标显示他在线；他也来得很早。这栋楼里大概只有我们两人。我猜他或许也在凝视着我的图标。终于，朗达第一个拖着步子走进办公室，那个绣满花纹的大包在她胸前沉甸甸地晃动。我紧盯着她走向座位的每个动作。整个周末在我脑中盘旋的所有问题此刻尖叫着涌现：她知道些什么？

beats.story: Did Kyle return to the bar and tell them everything? Rhonda pauses next to my desk and grins at me. "Hope everything's okay, dear. I didn't see you leave on Friday." My smile wobbles. "Yes, thank you. I was feeling a little ill." She nods once. "Been there." As she sets her bag onto her desk, I add, "But thanks for asking." And I really mean it. I guess it can be a little nice sometimes when she doesn't mind her own business.
beats.story_cn: 凯尔有没有回到酒吧把一切都说出去？朗达在我桌旁停下脚步，咧嘴对我笑了笑。“希望你没事，亲爱的。星期五我没看见你离场。”我的笑容晃了晃。“嗯，谢谢。我有点不舒服。”她点了点头。“懂那种感觉。”当她把包放在桌上时，我又补了句：“不过还是谢谢你关心。”我是真心这么觉得。有时候她不那么爱管闲事时，倒还挺让人暖心的。

beats.story: Sometimes. A little. When she doesn't ask any more questions, I feel a minuscule beat of relief. I doubt Rhonda would hold back if she'd heard a rumor about me, but then again, she was feeling that wine pretty good on Friday. Maybe she doesn't remember. I watch as she preens Joey's leaves, lips downturned. Armin trudges in next, hair mussed and eyes red. He nods my way before heading to the lunchroom.
beats.story_cn: 有时候吧。就一点点。只要她不再追问，我心里那根紧绷的弦就稍微松半毫米。我知道要是朗达听见什么风声肯定藏不住，但周五晚宴她可没少喝。也许…她根本没记住？我盯着她垂下眼帘替乔伊的盆栽理叶子的模样，心里打着鼓。接着是阿明踉跄着进来，头发乱得像鸟窝，眼眶通红。他朝我点了点头，径直走向了茶水间。

beats.story: Then Caitlin comes in, her cinnamon perfume wafting across the room as she heads to the fridge to stash her bland-looking chicken salad. I hold my breath and stare down at the little blinking light on my hard drive, following the sound of her routine as she reemerges to head to her desk, taking off her jacket and sliding into her chair. Every tiny motion stacks up against me. What does she know? Caitlin gets up and walks to Rhonda's desk. "Thanks for the party Friday night." Rhonda swivels her chair around. "Of course, dear! I'm glad you had fun." "It was a blast." Caitlin's voice sounds slightly hoarse.
beats.story_cn: 接着凯特琳进来了，肉桂香水的气息随着她走向冰箱安放那盒寡淡的鸡肉沙拉而弥漫开来。我屏住呼吸，死死盯着硬盘上闪烁的指示灯，听着她例行公事般折返、走向工位、脱下滑进座椅的声响。每个细微动作都像在审判我。她究竟知道多少？凯特琳起身走向朗达的工位：“谢谢周五的派对。”朗达转过身来：“当然亲爱的！玩得开心就好。”“简直棒极了。”凯特琳的嗓音带着丝沙哑。

beats.story: I glimpse at her over the cube wall; her demeanor is stiff. Suddenly, her gaze crawls to me. I try not to look tense as I nod a greeting. She passes behind my desk next, stopping in her tracks to look at me. Her mouth twists. "Oh, Jolene." My life stops. All the blood in my arteries freezes. "Thanks for decorating on Friday." What the hell?
beats.story_cn: 我从隔间墙沿偷瞄她；她的姿态僵硬如铁板。突然，她的视线像爬虫般挪到我身上。我尽力维持镇定颔首致意。下一秒她径直走到我工位后方，停下脚步盯着我。她的嘴角扭曲：“哦，乔琳。”我的时间停止了。血管里的血瞬间冻结。“谢谢周五的布置。”搞什么鬼？

beats.story: I search her face for any clue, anything to tell me what she knows, but her expression is imperceptible. "No problem." I smile for half a second, while her eyes shift and lock deeper into me, like she's trying to read something behind them. I try to keep still even as my heart pounds in my ears, my fingers tightening around my mouse. Then she simply turns and heads back to her desk. I release a breath. Caitlin's not the type to be coy about using any ammo she has against me. But I can't understand it. Did Kyle not tell her?
beats.story_cn: 我细察她的面容寻找蛛丝马迹，哪怕一缕暗示她已知悉的线索，可那张脸波澜不惊。“没关系。”我扯出半秒微笑，她的目光却悄然下移，更深地刺入我眼底，仿佛要透过虹膜捕捉我眼底的秘密。我僵坐着不敢动弹，任凭心在耳膜里擂鼓，指尖在鼠标上越攥越紧。她只是转身走回工位。我吐出一口憋了太久的气。凯特琳从来不是会藏着掖着的人——若她抓住了什么把柄，必定早已挥刀见血。可此刻我满心困惑：难道凯尔没告诉她？

From: Gregory Hall To: Caitlin Joffrey Subject: Re: meeting re: new ideas and info Caitlin, I appreciate that you are eager to workshop new ideas about the office, but there's not much time in my schedule available for this week. Not to worry, there will be other chances to discuss another day, I'm sure. Regards, Gregory I check Caitlin's sent folder. She'd emailed Gregory on a Saturday to request another meeting with him, saying she had "new information" to discuss about her project. My eyes flash to the top of Caitlin's head, visible above her screen. I hear the distinctive double tap of her opening the email.
beats.story_cn: 我看不出他有半分同情我的意思。就在凯特琳落座时，一封新邮件跃入她的屏幕。发件人：格里高利·霍尔；收件人：凯特琳·乔弗里；主题：回复：关于新提案与信息的会议 凯特琳，感谢你对办公室新提案的积极态度。但本周我的日程安排已满，抱歉难以抽空。别担心，将来必有机会再议。此致，格里高利。我迅速调出凯特琳的已发送邮件——她竟在周六邮件轰炸格里高利，声称掌握“新信息”要求重启会议。目光扫过她屏幕上方露出的发顶，耳畔传来她双击点开邮件特有的咔哒声。

Jolene, Hope the rest of the weekend went well. My apologies for having to do this, but a bit of an HR emergency has arisen, so I'm going to have to ask you to complete our next session at your desk. Because this is my doing, it won't count against you, and I'll be available to answer any questions. I've attached the booklet and worksheet. I trust this will be okay?
beats.story_cn: 就在这时我猛然察觉：她今天没点香薰机。她究竟知道多少？午休刚过，克利夫的邮件翩然而至。乔琳，希望你周末过得愉快。很抱歉出此下策，但人力资源部突发紧急事务，需请你回工位完成下一次咨询。因我方原因造成不便，此次不计入考核记录。附件包含手册与工作页，如有疑问请随时联系。望予理解？
